message.content:
Based on my search, here are the best places to get tickets for the next NBA game:

## Official NBA Ticket Sources

**1. NBA Official Ticketing Website (NBATickets.com)**
- The NBA's official ticketing website is **https://nbatickets.nba.com/**
- This is the only official ticket marketplace authorized by the NBA
- When you click "Buy Tickets," it redirects to Ticketmaster, which is the NBA's officially authorized ticketing platform
- All tickets purchased here are verified authentic by Ticketmaster's barcode authentication technology
- You can search for single game tickets, season ticket packages, group tickets, and special offers

**2. Ticketmaster**
- Website: **https://www.ticketmaster.com/**
- The official ticketing partner of the NBA
- Offers full-price original tickets and verified fan resale tickets
- All tickets are verified authentic
- Provides electronic delivery so you can print tickets within minutes or use mobile entry

## Secondary/Resale Marketplaces

**3. StubHub**
- Website: **https://www.stubhub.com/nba-tickets/grouping/115**
- One of the largest third-party resale platforms
- Tickets are plentiful and may be cheaper closer to game time
- Sellers resell and price tickets themselves

**4. SeatGeek**
- Website: **https://seatgeek.com/**
- Popular ticket aggregator platform
- Offers tickets for NBA, NFL, NHL, MLB, and more
- Has a feature that alerts users to ticket sales and discounts

**5. Vivid Seats / Viagogo**
- Website: **https://www.viagogo.com/cn/Sports-Tickets/Basketball/NBA**
- Another option for secondary market tickets

## Important Tips

- **Beware of scams**: Don't buy from private sellers on social media or forums unless you know them personally
- **Don't accept screenshot tickets**: Digital tickets must be officially transferred through the platform
- **Verify ticket transfer**: Make sure tickets can be added to your mobile wallet (Apple Wallet/Google Wallet)
- **Use secure payment methods**: Pay with credit card or PayPal for protection
- **Prices fluctuate**: Secondary market ticket prices often drop closer to game time

For the safest experience, I recommend starting with **https://nbatickets.nba.com/** or **https://www.ticketmaster.com/** for official tickets.
